structure: ruling-interaction-designer-2026-11-09.md: a short Markdown ruling file, 41 lines, holding the interaction designer's answers to the design questions the waiting-on-design rows were blocked on, passed on by Sam the same day (9 November 2026). Laid out in three pieces, in order: a heading and one-line provenance note (lines 1-3, naming the interaction designer as the author, Sam as the route, and the waiting-on-design blocked rows as the question set); a verbatim block quote of the interaction designer's own words (lines 5-21), six question-and-answer pairs each headed by the question's name and increment id — 'Search buttons (inc-188)' answered 'This has been picked up with the snagging list'; 'Region code prefix (inc-190)' answered 'Same above'; 'Amend pop-ups (inc-195)' answered 'These are no longer pop-ups, they are now proper pages which should remove the issue. Designs can be found in 2.1'; 'Templates sort (inc-162)' answered 'Templates has been dropped for now, this unlocks this ticket.'; 'CPH boxes - inc-093' answered 'No need to add the type behaviour on top, it should follow the gov.uk date input behaviour'; and 'Germinal date calendars (inc-192)' answered 'Keep the MOJ date picker.'; then a '## Decided' section (lines 23-41) with exactly six numbered items, one per quoted answer and in the same order, each a bolded headline sentence plus the design question number it answers (questions 1, 2, 9, 11 and 7, and 'the design question for c-283'), the behaviour it settles, the increments it drops or releases (inc-188 and inc-202; inc-190 and inc-204; inc-195 dropped, inc-120, inc-121 and inc-185 building the pages instead; inc-162 and its parked-theme copy inc-248 dropped; inc-093 dropped, inc-219 having built it; inc-192 released from blocked to todo, inc-206 having styled the picker) and a 'Confirms.' or 'New.' marker (items 1 and 2 confirm existing work, items 3 to 6 are new). The scope is 'whole file', so nothing is left out. At 41 lines the file is far smaller than one part, and the extract-ruling method needs the block quote and the numbered reading of it read side by side, so it is one part: the whole file, word for word, with the block quote as the source and the six numbered items as the main session's reading to be checked against it.

read: # Ruling: the interaction designer, 9 November 2026 - heading and provenance note (lines 1-3)

The verbatim block quote, all six question-and-answer pairs (lines 5-21): 'Search buttons (inc-188)', 'Region code prefix (inc-190)', 'Amend pop-ups (inc-195)', 'Templates sort (inc-162)', 'CPH boxes - inc-093', 'Germinal date calendars (inc-192)'
covers: The provenance: the interaction designer is the author, these are the answers to the design questions the waiting-on-design rows were blocked on, and Sam passed them on the same day - so the ruling's authority and which question set it answers

Every one of the six quoted answers, verbatim, as the source text the six numbered items must be checked against: 'This has been picked up with the snagging list' (search buttons, inc-188); 'Same above' (region code prefix, inc-190); 'These are no longer pop-ups, they are now proper pages which should remove the issue. Designs can be found in 2.1' (amend pop-ups, inc-195); 'Templates has been dropped for now, this unlocks this ticket.' (templates sort, inc-162); 'No need to add the type behaviour on top, it should follow the gov.uk date input behaviour' (CPH boxes, inc-093); 'Keep the MOJ date picker.' (germinal date calendars, inc-192)

Decision 1, search buttons (design question 1): already done - the joined blue search button was built in design snagging inc-202 from the designers' snagging list and inc-188 went with it; nothing changes; the item confirms existing work rather than being new
Decision 2, region code prefix (design question 2): already done - built in design snagging inc-204, which took in inc-190; nothing changes; the item confirms existing work rather than being new

Decision 3, amend and cancel amendment (design question 9): they are their own pages, not dialogs over the page; the Design Release 2.1 designs show them as pages; inc-120 and inc-121 (manage-notifications) build them and inc-185 builds them for germinal products; inc-195, the dialogs over the page, is dropped; marked New

Decision 4, templates sort (design question 11): no templates sort; templates are dropped for now, which ruling:sam-2026-11-04 had already parked, so that ruling settles the sort question; inc-162 and its copy in the parked templates theme, inc-248, are dropped; marked New

Decision 4's open point: the quote's 'dropped for now' and the item's 'If templates come back, the sort comes back as a question with them' leave the sort unsettled for any future return of templates - a gap claim naming that open point, never a decision

Decision 5, the county parish holding boxes (design question 7): they take no JavaScript on top and behave as the GOV.UK date input does - separate labelled boxes, no digit filter, no paste spreading and no focus moving; that is what design snagging-b inc-219 built; inc-093 is dropped; marked New

Decision 6, the germinal dates (the design question for c-283): they keep the MOJ date picker - each germinal date gets the 'Choose date' calendar, the Ministry of Justice date picker every other date in both frontends uses and design snagging inc-206 styled; it is not replaced by the three-part date input; inc-192 is released from blocked to todo; marked New

For each of the six numbered items, whether the block quote says it in so many words (verbatim) or only implies it (inferred, naming the words that imply it) - the quote answers at headline level only, so the snagging increment ids (inc-202, inc-204, inc-219, inc-206), the increments that build the amend and cancel-amendment pages (inc-120, inc-121, inc-185), the parked-theme copy inc-248, the cross-reference to ruling:sam-2026-11-04, the specific behaviours ruled out on the CPH boxes (digit filter, paste spreading, focus moving), the 'Choose date' label and 'every other date in both frontends' claim, and every drop or release of an increment are the main session's reading to be marked accordingly

Which earlier conflict or report question each item answers where the item names one - item 6 names conflict c-283 - and the design question number each item answers (1, 2, 9, 11, 7), recorded in the claim's note
